rules.statement: A person having title only to an undivided share of a land, but who has been in occupation of a specific portion of the land, cannot oust another co-owner from that portion by suing for a possessory decree unless exceptional circumstances are present.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is not generally open to a person having title only to an undivided share of a land, but who has been in occupation of a specific portion of the land, to oust another co-owner from that portion by suing for a possessory decree."
